He climbed back up the winding stairs, lit the great lamp as he did every evening, and resolved to find the sailor's family and finally deliver the words the ocean had kept safe.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还在沉睡。街道空旷，路灯把光洒在湿漉漉的柏油路上。偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，车灯划破黑暗，又很快消失在街角。早餐铺的师傅已经起身，蒸笼里升起白色的热气。远处的高楼只剩零星的窗亮着灯，像疲惫的眼睛。天边泛起一丝灰蓝，鸟还没有醒，风很轻。这是城市最安静的时刻，也是它悄悄换气、准备迎接新一天的时刻。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller copy of the same problem.\n• Think of standing in line and asking the person ahead, 'How many are in front of you?', until someone at the front says zero.\n• Each step gets simpler until it reaches the easiest case, then all the answers add back up."}
